Hi Caden / Amira —

Congrats again on signing. Per the MPA we discussed, attached is our proposed "shadow launch" plan that lives inside the MAP: a sequenced rollout that combines a 7-day shadow canary, a staged traffic ramp, and two 3-day skill-transfer sprints for your SRE and product teams. High-level asks below, and I included the validation rubric and rollback gates in the workbook attachment.

Top-level asks for the week-of Jan 11 (proposed):
- Provide a single test workspace and two service accounts (read-only) for shadow testing by Jan 6.
- Confirm a preferred maintenance window for a 1-hour production traffic cutover on Jan 18.
- Assign 2 engineers for the skill-transfer sprints (Jan 12–14 and Jan 15–17).

What you'll find in the attachments:
- Luminexa_MAP_v1.2.pdf: mutual-action-plan with milestones (onboarding -> shadow -> go-live)
- shadow-canary-checklist.xlsx: step-by-step canary runbook, observability lanes, KPI thresholds and rollback criteria
- skill-transfer-sprint-agenda.docx: hands-on sessions, runbook ownership transfer, and acceptance criteria

Key notes on observability and acceptance:
- We'll use route-level latency and 99th percentile token time as primary SLOs, and will compare output quality metrics against your pre-approved evaluators in the rubric.
- Automated prefix/KV cache warmup is included in shadow runs to simulate production token economics; we will record cost delta and share a short report.

Next steps: if you confirm the service accounts and the Jan 12 sprint owners by EOD Jan 6, we will lock the runbook and provision the test capacity.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,

Hi all —

Attached v1 of the instrumented checklist (see also Drive folder). Highlights:
- Day 0: smoke tests + KMS/service-account verification (automated)
- Shadow Days 1–3: read-only shadow traffic, output-sampling at 1% with the manual QA checkpoint at EOD Day 3 (120 samples)
- Shadow Days 4–7: progressive cache warm-up and traffic replay (10% -> 25% traffic sim)
- Acceptance gates: quality pass (>= 92% on rubric), no more than 2 SLA alerts > 95th percentile latency in 24 hours
- Rollback gates: immediate rollback to fallback model on any critical fidelity fail or repeated CPU/GPU OOMs

I also added a short section on "observability lanes" (per-route latency histograms, token-level breakdowns, and cost delta charts) so the client can see unit economics during the shadow.

Aisha — will add the final checklist into the MAP doc and send to DocuSign once Vivek confirms the SLA/credits note.

-Marissa

Attachments: shadow-canary-checklist_v1.xlsx
